name: a show link previews in a window only again (G3's rule)
why: Phase 8: on a Brucebase page a /<yyyy>#<ddmmyy> link is no longer the site's own; with the inWindow condition back it resolves to nothing on the page.

name: a relative show link is not read against the page
why: The wiki writes "/1978#070778" relative; without the BB branch _extTarget() drops every non-absolute href.

name: every relative Brucebase link read against the page
why: Only the show shape is another reader's: a relative /1978 (the year page) or /gig:… must stay the site's own (no ext card claiming it before the Brucebase sources).

name: bbdate: a lettered anchor turned away again
why: An anchor with a letter (/1985#310385b) is a show of its year page too.
grep: the window of a lettered anchor

name: bbdate: the 1949-64 page turned away again
why: The early years' combined page (/1949-64#230949) is a year page.

name: bbdate: a relative lettered anchor not made absolute
why: Brucebase writes a show link relative (/1985#310385b): read against the page, or it is no other site.

name: bbdate: any letters after the anchor
why: One letter at most; '/1985#310385ab' is no show link. The test writes it relative, and the relative-link pattern (one letter) already refuses it, so the reader's own limit is covered and no spec can see it.

name: year reader: the setlist's note dropped
why: The year page's <sup> note ends the setlist paragraph; it is no song. Since version 6 _bbSplitSet() takes it out, and the reader keeps it as setlistNote: dropped, the note is gone from the window.

name: year reader: the note not drawn under the tracks
why: The window shows the note on its own line under the tracklist.

name: year reader: a note without tracks not drawn
why: An entry with only "No set details known." shows it under a plain Tracklist heading.
grep: a show with only the note

name: year reader: the cache version not bumped
why: Year pages kept with the glued song must be read again (version 5). The specs parse fresh pages, so no spec can see a stale IndexedDB entry.

name: year reader: a prose first paragraph read as a set
why: Version 6: only paragraphs the year table's classifier calls set or note are sets; a description paragraph is no one-song setlist (2016-10-03 Barnes & Noble).
grep: an entry read as the year table reads it

name: year reader: a description of plain paragraphs not read
why: 2,732 of 5,009 entries have their description as plain paragraphs, not a .list-pages-box (1985-03-31b).

name: year reader: a set's label lost
why: A label ("Soundcheck") groups its songs in the window.
grep: an entry read as the year table reads it
